texts: You won't hear when a rider offers or when your parcel arrives. Open system settings
These show your phone's real settings — LyniaGo re-checks them every time you come back to the app. Changing one opens Android settings.

extra.reason: The base LJ.settings mock (screens.jsx Settings) draws an 'Edit profile' row; the SH11 settings_perms shipped-state focuses its gallery tile on the permissions section and omits it, but the real app settings screen is the union of both mocks.

Entry row to the SH7 Privacy screen this lane built — the mock draws Privacy as a destination screen (screens-shipped.jsx Privacy), reached from settings; the settings_perms shipped-state omits the reachability row.
The base LJ.settings mock draws a 'Sign out' danger row at the bottom of the settings list; the focused SH11 permissions shipped-state omits it, but the real settings screen keeps it.
Entry row to the DeleteAccount screen this lane built — the mock draws DeleteAccount as a destination (screens-shipped.jsx DeleteAccount); the settings_perms shipped-state omits the reachability row.

undrawn.reason: Section header for a section that no longer exists: the permission rows moved INTO the single settings card (owner instruction 2026-08-16, 'Permissions must fall under the same card and not be separate'), so the all-caps label framed nothing and was dropped with the split it labelled.

undrawn.reason: Framing paragraph for the same retired section, dropped by the same owner decision. The behaviour it described is unchanged and still asserted: both rows read the live OS permission and tap through to Android settings, and a DENIED permission still spells out its consequence inline on the row.
